sources.title: Customizing Language Model Responses with Contrastive In-Context Learning
sources.snippet: The "contrastive-combined" approach (which combines the contrastive examples and the derived instruction) achieved the best performance for most cases. Using similar number of tokens in prompt, this contrastive in-context learning approach performs significantly better than standard few-shot approach, as shown in Figure 3.
